screen.skygrid.config.title: Sky Grid
screen.skygrid.config.subtitle: Saved immediately. New chunks only.
screen.skygrid.config.search.tooltip: Filters this list. Matches block names, ids and mod ids.
screen.skygrid.config.filter.tooltip: Listed shows entries saved for this dimension. All blocks shows everything you can add.
screen.skygrid.config.dimension.tooltip: Each dimension has its own list. Left and right change it while this bar is focused.
screen.skygrid.config.empty.search.hint: Try a block name, an id, or a mod id.
screen.skygrid.config.empty.pool.hint: Choose All blocks to add some.
screen.skygrid.config.remove.confirm: Click Remove to drop %s. New chunks only.
screen.skygrid.config.saved.add: Added %s at weight %s. Saved — new chunks only.
screen.skygrid.config.saved.weight: %s weight is now %s. Saved — new chunks only.
screen.skygrid.config.save.fail: Could not write the config file. See the log.
screen.skygrid.config.weight.tooltip: Weight %s. Higher appears more often. Shift-click changes it by 10.
screen.skygrid.config.row.excluded: Blacklist: this block is kept out of the world. Weights are not used. Click the box, then Remove, to allow it.
screen.skygrid.config.row.out.blacklist: Not excluded. Click Add to keep it out of the world.
screen.skygrid.config.row.in: Listed. Click the box, then Remove, to drop it.
screen.skygrid.config.row.out: Not listed. Click Add to include it at weight 1.
screen.skygrid.config.row.tag: Tag. Every matching block is placed when chunks generate.
screen.skygrid.config.row.missing: This id is not registered. It is still saved.
screen.skygrid.config.reload.tooltip: Read all three config files from disk.
screen.skygrid.config.reload.title: Reload configs?
screen.skygrid.config.reload.body: Replace the lists in this editor with skygrid.json, skygrid_nether.json and skygrid_end.json. If a file cannot be read, nothing is changed. Applies to newly generated chunks only.
screen.skygrid.config.reload.ok: Reloaded all three configs. New chunks only.
command.skygrid.help.line1: /skygrid blocks [log] [dim]  ·  reload  ·  add/remove/weight  ·  tag add/remove  ·  chance [type] [0-1] [dim]
command.skygrid.help.line2: /skygridgui opens the block editor. Changes only affect newly generated chunks.
command.skygrid.status.not_skygrid: This dedicated server is not using Sky Grid. Set level-type=skygrid:skygrid in server.properties before generating the world.
command.skygrid.reload.success: All dimension configs reloaded. Pools rebuild on the next chunk generation.
command.skygrid.reload.fail: Reload failed and nothing was changed: %s
command.skygrid.chunk_note: Applies to newly generated chunks only — existing terrain is unchanged.
command.skygrid.add.noop: %s is already in the %s pool with weight %s — nothing to do.
command.skygrid.weight.missing: %s is not in the %s pool. Use /skygrid add first.
command.skygrid.weight.noop: %s already has weight %s in %s — nothing to do.
command.skygrid.unknown_block: No such block: %s — it is not registered. Check the mod is installed.
command.skygrid.unknown_dimension: Unknown dimension '%s' — expected overworld, nether or end.
command.skygrid.tag.add.empty: That tag currently matches nothing. Kept anyway — it will apply if a mod defining it is installed later.
command.skygrid.blocks.more: Showing first %s of %s — use /skygrid blocks log [dimension] for the full list
command.skygrid.blocks.log.ok: Full list dumped to the game log.
command.skygrid.chance.noop: %s chance in %s is already %s (%s%%) — nothing to do.
command.skygrid.chance.unknown: Unknown chance type '%s' — expected spawner, chest or cluster.
